contexts.text: The evils which are to be dispersed, that is loosened and tempered by goods. AC 731.
(They believe) that the evils and falsities with man are entirely dispersed and abolished; (whereas) there is not a single evil or falsity so dispersed as to be abolished...
Such a cloud can be easily dispersed...
With them, the fallacies taken from the sense of the letter are easily dispersed.
These (scientifics and pleasures) are first to be dispersed; and when they have been dispersed... AC 1563:2.
Temptations... are the means by which evils and falsities are loosened and dispersed.
These reasonings are dispersed by...
Such things are dispersed by means of the internal sense of the Word, and are thus perfected.
The principles of falsity imbued from infancy... are first to be dispersed...
Nor does the truth which flows in appear... to be able to disperse falsities and evils.
As these things are dispersed by the Angels...
The truths through which falsities are dispersed...
Truths... labour to shake off falsities from themselves.
Unless the negatives of truth are dispersed...
The fallacies... which are to be dispersed...
Until such ideas were dispersed...
It is important to disperse the fallacies...
May by rational things be dispersed...
Until (the confirmed falsities) are dispersed, truths cannot be seen.
In proportion as he sees these evils, they can be dispersed; for no evil can be dispersed until it is seen.
As soon as these concupiscences have been dispersed by the Lord... (Repeated three times.)
These appearances the mind cannot shake off, except by...
Concupiscences are then dispersed...
Afterwards, to disperse evils with their falsities.
Shake off the leaf ().
